text:
sophie-sales: Starting a POC run for Terralabs today at 14:00 PST. Need runbook + ops oncall. Goal: sustain 200 qps, 95% <= 120ms, p99 < 350ms. Pricing and security questions too. Can ops/eng confirm config and quick ballpark cost? :eyes:

alex-se: Copy. Model Q? Sales said open weights. Suggest smoke on open-llama-13b-quant first, then scale to open-llama-70b-quant if accuracy requires it.

kevin-eng: Ops notes: need VPC peering + S3 logs. Warmup plan: 10k priming tokens per instance, 5m warmup. Also recommend 30s request timeout + retry 2.

maria-ops: I'll provision a dedicated pool: 4 GPUs to start (can autoscale to 8). Autoscale policy: instant_burst:2, max_replicas:8. After smoke I'll upload heatmaps.

alex-se: Bench command I'd run: 
```
redwood bench --model open-llama-13b-quant --qps 200 --concurrency 50 --duration 20m --warmup 5m
```
Also enable KV cache and prefix caching for repeated prompts.

lisa-security: Quick security checklist: where will logs live? Is data transiting our hosted plane or in customer's VPC? Need SAS/SSQ + confirmation of KMS/HSM usage before prod testing.

alex-se: Pricing roughball: sustained 200 qps on 13B quant with a dedicated 4-GPU pool => approx $5k/day infra estimate (DMing more conservative numbers). For customer facing quote we'll refine after run.

sophie-sales: Timeline: smoke at 13:30 for warmup, full run at 14:00. @kevin-eng are you oncall? I'll notify Terralabs and legal for the SAS.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy for bench-run terralabs-pool started at 13:40 :rocket:

kevin-eng: I'm oncall 13:15-15:00. Config recs: timeout 30s, retries 2, cb_failure_threshold 3. If p99 climbs >350ms, we'll fallback to lower qps or swap model.

maria-ops: After run I'll upload: s3://redwood-poc-terralabs/bench/5378901234/ with heatmap, latency_histogram.csv, and a short notes.md

alex-se: If p99 >350ms consider: reduce QPS by 20% or switch to smaller model variant. Also capture request traces for slow tails.

sophie-sales: Thanks team :trophy: -- go ahead with smoke. I'll track blockers and update Terralabs slack channel.
